      About this item

      • Compatibility: only for iPhone Air/17/17e/16/15/14/13/12 series, Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra/S26+/S26/S25 Ultra/S25 +/S25 with a magnetic case; for optimal charging, use the cable provided with a USB-C to C charger of ≥ 20W；recommended to use with official or ESR magnetic cases; not compatible with Motorola, OnePlus, and Google phones
      • Fast Charging: 15W MagSafe charging and CryoBoost phone-cooling tech combine to ensure safer, more reliable charging at faster speeds
      • Stay Cooler: CryoBoost phone-cooling fan and innovative heat-dissipating components keep your phone cooler during charging, maintaining maximum charging speeds
      • Strong Magnetic Lock: powerful ring of magnets with 1,600 g of holding force keeps your phone securely in place, even on bumpy roads; an official MagSafe case or ESR magnetic case is recommended for rough terrain

        • Draco
          5 out of 5 stars
          One Year Later — Still One of the Best Car Accessories I’ve Bought
          Reviewed in the United States on 10 March 2026
          Style Name: 15W-Phone Cooling Car Charger
          Verified Purchase
          Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
          Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

          I’ve owned this charger for exactly one year now, and I can confidently say it’s one of the best car accessories I’ve purchased. It still works just as well as the day I bought it.

          The MagSafe magnetic hold is strong and reliable, so my phone snaps right into place and stays there even on rough roads. Once your phone is attached, it does not move no matter how many bumps you go over. It’s perfect for keeping my phone visible for GPS while driving.

          What really makes this a game changer is how versatile it’s been. I’ve used it in multiple cars, including rental cars I’ve taken out for work. Not every car has CarPlay or built-in navigation, so having this mount means I can always keep my phone accessible for directions while it charges at the same time.

          I’ve used it with an iPhone 13 Pro Max, an iPhone 15 Pro, and even a Samsung device, and it has handled all of them without issues. Charging is quick and consistent, and the cooling feature helps prevent the phone from overheating during longer drives.

          Installation is simple, just clip it to any vent, the mount feels super sturdy, and the overall design looks sleek inside the car.

          After a full year of daily use across different vehicles, it’s still going strong. If you rely on your phone for navigation and want a reliable charger/mount combo, I honestly can’t recommend this enough.
